verdict.line: You lose if you trade Q or W autos into an up Counter Strike or let fights drag out past level 6 where his 0-cooldown R snowballs attack speed; you win if you poke safely with E and only commit Q/W all-ins once his E is confirmed down.

brief.thesis: Jax's E (Counter Strike) only dodges basic attacks, so Volibear's two main damage tools — Q's attack-triggered stun and W's on-hit trade — can be baited and wasted while E (Sky Splitter), a ground-targeted bolt, cannot be dodged that way. The matchup is decided by using E as the safe poke tool and saving Q/W all-ins for windows when Counter Strike is down, which the measured 42.6% win rate over 2679 games and Jax's lane and solo-kill advantage both reflect when that cooldown isn't tracked.

theirWindow.what: Jax can bait a Q (Thundering Smash) or W (Frenzied Maul) trade, dodge the attack with Counter Strike, then stun and burst you back for free — decline the trade and poke with E instead.

yourWindow.what: All-in with Q (Thundering Smash) for a guaranteed stun since he has nothing to dodge it with, then double-tap W (Frenzied Maul) on the marked target for the bonus damage and heal.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The dominant start in measured games (43.1% win rate, 68.9% pick over 2255 games) — the mana regen keeps you slinging E (Sky Splitter) to poke every 16 seconds without running dry, since that's your only safe damage tool before Counter Strike punishes your autos.

boots.why: Highest-picked boots in the data (43.9% win rate, 55% pick over 1656 games) and the right mechanical fit — Jax's whole kit, including his R's attack-speed stacking, is basic-attack damage, which Steelcaps directly reduces.

core.why: First item in the top two measured build paths; the stat split keeps you relevant in both the early poke phase and the later on-hit trades.
Cooldown refund loops your Q and W faster for the all-in windows when Counter Strike is down, part of the measured 47.7% win rate path over 197 games.
Magic resist plus healing amp on W's (Frenzied Maul) self-heal, completing the measured core that holds a 47.7% win rate over 197 games.

runes.keystoneWhy: Most-picked page in the data (28.2% pick, 41.8% win rate) and it rewards exactly the extended-fight attack speed scaling your on-hit core (Navori Flickerblade, Statikk Shiv) is built around.

summoners.why: Highest win rate of the measured combos (44.2%) — Exhaust directly neutralizes Jax's 0-cooldown R (Relentless Assault) attack-speed stacking and softens an empowered Leap Strike all-in, which matters more here than the more popular Flash+Ignite line (61% pick).

playing.title: Poke with E, not autos
playing.detail: Use E (Sky Splitter) to chip Jax from range since it's a ground-targeted lightning bolt, not a basic attack — Counter Strike only dodges basic attacks, so it can't avoid this damage, and you gain a shield if you're caught in your own blast.

playing.title: Never commit Q or W into an up Counter Strike
playing.detail: If Jax's E (Counter Strike, 18/16/14/12/10s cooldown) is available, don't initiate with Q (Thundering Smash) or trade W (Frenzied Maul) autos — he'll dodge the attack and stun you back for free.

playing.title: All-in only when Counter Strike is down
playing.detail: Track his E cooldown; once it's down, Q in for the guaranteed stun, then double-tap W (Frenzied Maul) on the marked target for the bonus damage and heal.

playing.title: Watch for his empowered Leap Strike
playing.detail: Jax's W (Empower, 7/6/5/4/3s cooldown) buffs his next attack or Q (Leap Strike, 17/14/11/8/5s cooldown) — if you see the buff up with Q off cooldown, expect a gap-close and punish once Empower is spent.

playing.title: Keep fights short past level 6
playing.detail: Jax's R (Relentless Assault) has 0 cooldown and ramps attack speed on every strike, with every third hit dealing bonus damage — extended auto-trading snowballs in his favor, so burst with Q-stun and double-W instead of standing and swinging.

playing.title: Itemize against his on-hit scaling
playing.detail: Spirit Visage's healing amp boosts your W sustain; add Thornmail if he goes crit-heavy and starts winning the extended duels your early poke was supposed to prevent.

playing.title: Stand in your own E for the shield
playing.detail: Sky Splitter grants you a shield only if you're inside its own blast radius — poke from a position where you catch that shield before committing further into a trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner spells are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.19.1); the tactical reading — poking with E instead of trading autos into Counter Strike, and timing all-ins around his E cooldown — is our own analysis, not something OP.GG states.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid using [Q][W] when Jax is using Counter Strike (E). Use [E] to contest lane and close in when the enemy’s abilities are on cooldown to engage.
